mentions.name: AT1C Protocol
mentions.description: AT1C Protocol is an SDK (published as the @at1c/sdk npm package) for building AI agents that require human consent before acting. Its receipt mechanism lets users verify what agents did rather than trusting the operator, enabling consent-gated, auditable agent behavior.
mentions.problem: AI agent actions lack verifiable human consent and independent verification, requiring users to blindly trust the operator.
mentions.source_excerpt: AT1C Protocol AI Agents require Human consent. Don't trust us Verify the Receipt.
